title: Caleb's Data Analysis
output: html_notebook

First, let's load our libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```


Next, let's load our data set and clean it up

```{r}
Student_Responses <- read.csv("data/student_responses.csv") |> clean_names()
```

Now, time to analyze

1Q. Which news organizations are student listening to the most this past month?

```{r}
Student_Responses |> 
  group_by(most_frequent_news_organization) |> 
  summarise(count=n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))
```

1Q. Most of the sample has read the New York Times the most frequently during last month. 


2Q. Which race/ethnicity of students most frequently read the Times this past month?

```{r}
Student_Responses |>
  filter(str_detect(most_frequent_news_organization, "New York Times")) |>
  group_by(race_ethnicity) |>
  summarise(count=n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))
```

A2. In the sample, white journalism student have read the Times the most.
